title: Ohio Mutual Auto Claim
description: Complete claim state schema for multi-agent insurance claims processing pipeline. This schema is the contract between all 7 agents -- every field name here is exactly what agents read and write.

claim_id.description: Unique claim identifier in format CLM-YYYY-NNNNN (e.g., CLM-2026-00001)

status.description: Current claim status in the processing pipeline state machine. Transitions: FNOL_RECEIVED -> COVERAGE_CHECKED -> ASSESSED -> FRAUD_ANALYZED -> REVIEWED -> PAYMENT_ISSUED or DENIED. ESCALATED and ERROR can occur from any stage.

submitted_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the claim was first submitted (FNOL received)

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to this claim record

claimant.description: Information about the person filing the claim

policy_id.description: Policy identifier linking to the mock policy database (e.g., POL-AUT-98765)

name.description: Full name of the claimant (policyholder or authorized representative)

contact_phone.description: Claimant phone number for follow-up communication

contact_email.description: Claimant email address for written correspondence and status updates

incident.description: Details of the incident being claimed

location.description: Location where the incident occurred (address, intersection, or description)

description.description: Free-text description of what happened, as reported by the claimant

type.description: Category of incident: collision (two+ vehicles), comprehensive (non-collision damage), liability (claimant at fault for third-party damage), theft (vehicle stolen), vandalism (intentional damage), weather (hail, flood, tornado)

other_party.description: Information about the other party involved, if applicable (collision/liability claims)

name.description: Name of the other party involved in the incident

contact.description: Other party's contact information (phone or email)

police_report_number.description: Police report number if law enforcement responded to the incident

photos.description: Array of file paths to uploaded photos of damage (relative to shared/uploads/)

injuries_reported.description: Whether any injuries were reported in connection with this incident

statement.description: Brief summary of witness statement, if available

witnesses.description: Array of witness information for the incident

pipeline.description: Processing results from each pipeline stage. Each section is written by the corresponding agent and read by downstream agents.

front_desk.description: Stage 1: FNOL intake, categorization, and completeness check. Written by the Front Desk agent.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when Front Desk completed processing

agent_session.description: OpenClaw session key for this agent run (for transcript retrieval via sessions_history)

category.description: Claim category determined during intake (e.g., standard collision, complex multi-vehicle, weather event)

priority.description: Priority level based on severity, injuries, and time sensitivity

cat_event.description: Catastrophe event identifier if this claim is part of a declared CAT event (e.g., CAT-2026-003-tornado)

missing_info.description: List of information items that are missing or need follow-up from the claimant

claims_officer.description: Stage 2: Policy lookup, coverage verification, and exclusion check. Written by the Claims Officer agent.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when Claims Officer completed processing

agent_session.description: OpenClaw session key for this agent run

covered.description: Whether the claim is covered under the policy (true = covered, false = denied, null = not yet determined)

policy_status.description: Current status of the claimant's policy at time of incident

coverage_type.description: Applicable coverage type from the policy (e.g., collision, comprehensive, liability, UM/UIM)

deductible_amount.description: Deductible amount in USD applicable to this claim based on coverage type

coverage_limit.description: Maximum coverage limit in USD for this claim type under the policy

exclusions_checked.description: List of policy exclusions that were reviewed and their applicability (documents due diligence per FCSP Act)

denial_reason.description: If coverage is denied, the specific reason referencing policy language and applicable exclusion

um_uim_route.description: Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist routing: UM if other party has no insurance, UIM if other party has insufficient coverage, not_applicable otherwise

assessor.description: Stage 3: Damage estimation, total loss determination, and repair recommendation. Written by the Assessor agent.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when Assessor completed processing

agent_session.description: OpenClaw session key for this agent run

repair_estimate_usd.description: Total estimated repair cost in USD (parts + labor + paint + materials)

total_loss.description: Whether the vehicle is a total loss (repair cost exceeds threshold percentage of ACV, typically 70-75% in Ohio)

acv_usd.description: Actual Cash Value of the vehicle in USD (market value minus depreciation)

salvage_value_usd.description: Estimated salvage value if total loss is declared

parts_recommendation.description: Parts recommendation: OEM for vehicles under 3yr/36K miles or safety-critical repairs, aftermarket otherwise (judgment-based, not hardcoded)

labor_hours.description: Estimated labor hours for repair work

rental_days.description: Estimated number of rental car days needed during repair (if rental coverage applies)

pre_existing_damage_flags.description: List of pre-existing damage indicators found during assessment (cross-referenced with fraud analysis)

hidden_damage_likely.description: Whether hidden damage is likely based on impact type and visible damage patterns (may trigger supplement)

fraud_analyst.description: Stage 4: Fraud risk scoring, pattern matching, and SIU referral recommendation. Written by the Fraud Analyst agent.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when Fraud Analyst completed processing

agent_session.description: OpenClaw session key for this agent run

risk_score.description: Fraud risk score from 0 (no indicators) to 100 (multiple converging fraud patterns). Not a probability -- represents indicator convergence strength.

risk_level.description: Risk level derived from indicator convergence: low (isolated minor flags), medium (multiple flags but no convergence), high (converging indicators), critical (pattern match with known fraud scheme)

pattern.description: Fraud pattern identifier (e.g., staged_accident, phantom_passenger, inflated_repair, prior_damage, vin_switching)

description.description: Human-readable explanation of why this flag was raised

flags.description: Array of fraud flags raised during analysis, each with pattern type, explanation, and severity

soft_fraud.description: Whether soft fraud indicators are present (exaggeration/inflation of legitimate claim vs. fabricated claim)

recommendation.description: Fraud analyst recommendation: CLEAR (proceed normally), INVESTIGATE (senior reviewer should scrutinize), REFER_SIU (Special Investigations Unit referral required)

senior_reviewer.description: Stage 5: Final decision authority weighing all prior stages, compliance check, and human escalation trigger. Written by the Senior Reviewer agent.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when Senior Reviewer completed processing

agent_session.description: OpenClaw session key for this agent run

decision.description: Final claim decision: APPROVED (proceed to payment), DENIED (with documented reason), CONDITIONAL (approved with conditions), ESCALATE_HUMAN (requires human adjuster review)

decision_reasoning.description: Detailed reasoning for the decision, referencing evidence from prior pipeline stages and applicable regulations

conditions.description: List of conditions that must be met for a CONDITIONAL approval (e.g., additional documentation, inspection, IME)

escalated_to_human.description: Whether this claim has been escalated to a human adjuster for final decision

escalation_reason.description: Reason for human escalation, if applicable (e.g., high fraud risk, complex coverage question, regulatory concern)

fcsp_timeline_check.description: Fair Claims Settlement Practices Act timeline compliance verification

acknowledgment_deadline.description: Deadline for acknowledgment of claim receipt (typically 15 business days per FCSP)

decision_deadline.description: Deadline for claim decision communication (typically 30 business days per FCSP)

payment_deadline.description: Deadline for payment after approval (typically 30 business days per FCSP)

compliant.description: Whether current processing timeline is within FCSP Act requirements

finance.description: Stage 6: Payment calculation, deductible application, depreciation, and disbursement record. Written by the Finance agent.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when Finance completed processing

agent_session.description: OpenClaw session key for this agent run

payment_amount_usd.description: Final payment amount in USD after all deductions (repair estimate or ACV minus deductible minus depreciation)

deductible_applied_usd.description: Deductible amount deducted from the claim payment in USD

depreciation_applied_usd.description: Depreciation amount deducted from parts or vehicle value in USD

subrogation_candidate.description: Whether this claim is a subrogation candidate (other party at fault, recovery possible from other party's insurer)

subrogation_target.description: Target for subrogation recovery (other party's insurance company name and policy number)

payment_reference.description: Payment transaction reference number (mock for hackathon)

supplement_eligible.description: Whether this claim is eligible for supplemental payment if hidden damage is discovered during repair

audit_log.description: Append-only audit trail of every agent action and decision. Required for FCSP Act compliance and demonstration of transparent AI decision-making.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of this audit entry

agent.description: Agent ID that performed this action (router, front-desk, claims-officer, assessor, fraud-analyst, senior-reviewer, finance)

action.description: Action taken (e.g., claim_registered, intake_completed, coverage_verified, coverage_denied, estimate_completed, fraud_flags_raised, decision_approved, payment_issued, escalated_to_human)

reasoning.description: The agent's actual reasoning for this action -- not a code, but a human-readable explanation of why this decision was made

regulation_reference.description: Reference to applicable regulation or policy if this action has regulatory implications (e.g., FCSP Act Section 2695.7(b), Ohio Rev. Code 3937.18)
